text: Yeah, some things are easier to manage with calories or time, but you can also manage them and track them with distance. I wouldn't completely throw away distance. Yes, the blue, green, and orange aerobic work can run on different things that are available, different tools: a runner, a skier. For non-runners, it is completely fine, and there are more options. I just want you to make sure that they understand that doing the block is the important part, and being able to track it and see any changes week to week is important.
